The simplest way to think about it: Qi2 is the 15W magnetic wireless charging standard, Qi2.2 is the newer 25W version, and MagSafe is Apple's magnetic charging technology and accessory ecosystem. They're closely related, and modern chargers can support more than one.

Qi2 vs. Qi2.2 vs. MagSafe
1. Qi2
Up to 15W

An open wireless charging standard developed by the Wireless Power Consortium (WPC). It introduced magnetic alignment inspired by Apple's MagSafe technology, helping phones attach securely and charge efficiently.

Best for: Reliable magnetic charging at a generally lower cost.

Source: Wireless Power Consortium

2. Qi2.2 (Qi2 25W)
Up to 25W

The faster evolution of Qi2. The WPC's Qi v2.2.1 standard, branded Qi2 25W, launched in July 2025. It retains magnetic alignment while increasing maximum wireless charging power by nearly 70% over 15W Qi2.

Best for: People who want faster wireless charging and a charger that supports the newer standard.

Source: WPC standard overview

3. MagSafe
Apple technology

Apple's magnetic attachment and charging system for compatible iPhones and accessories. Apple's current MagSafe Charger is also certified for Qi2 25W and ordinary Qi charging, so MagSafe and Qi2 are no longer mutually exclusive.

Best for: iPhone owners who want Apple's own charger and accessory experience.

Source: Apple MagSafe Charger

Actual speeds depend on the phone, charger, power adapter, temperature and software. A 25W-rated charger does not make every phone charge at 25W.

How much faster is Qi2.2?

Qi2

15W maximum

Qi2.2

25W maximum

Theoretical maximum power, not a promise of proportionally faster real-world charging. The WPC says Qi2 25W can charge a smartphone from 0% to about 50% in roughly 30 minutes under suitable conditions.

The practical difference is that Qi2.2 offers up to 67% more power than 15W Qi2. But charging speed usually tapers as a battery fills, so it won't necessarily be 67% faster overall.

Bottom line

Choose Qi2 if 15W magnetic charging is enough.

Choose Qi2.2 if your phone supports 25W Qi2 charging and you want the faster option.

Choose MagSafe if you prefer Apple's own charging accessory and ecosystem. You can also get Apple's MagSafe experience with a charger certified for Qi2 25W.
